milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the standalone oak log tree at relative position (6, 2, 2) and face it, confirming they have visually located it. Target is the mid-trunk of the oak log tree. Max distance of 8 blocks and facing tolerance of 60° ensures the player is looking at the tree.

Uses inventory_has because mining oak_planks in survival mode drops the oak_planks item into inventory. The player starts with 64 oak_planks, so requiring 65 proves at least 1 block was actually mined from the oak plank building. This is the preferred rule type for mine tasks (mined drop ends up in inventory).

Uses count_in_box_at_least (kind=block) because this is a build/place task. The player must place oak_planks blocks inside the stone brick building interior to wall off a section, creating a hidden room. The box covers the stone brick building interior (relative coords -2,0,-8 to 4,3,-5). Requiring at least 6 oak_planks ensures a meaningful wall partition (e.g., 3 high × 2 wide) rather than just a single column. The generous box (7×4×4) gives the player freedom in where they build the partition.
